import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch

def wrap(t, width=22):
    words=t.split(); lines=[]; cur=""
    for w in words:
        if len(cur)+len(w)+1<=width: cur=(cur+" "+w).strip()
        else: lines.append(cur); cur=w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return "\n".join(lines)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 11)); ax.axis('off')

def box(x,y,w,h,text,fc,fs=8.5):
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x,y),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.02,rounding_size=0.06",
                 fc=fc,ec='black',lw=1.2,zorder=2))
    ax.text(x+w/2,y+h/2,wrap(text),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=fs,zorder=3)
def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,color='black',lw=1.6):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle='-|>',mutation_scale=16,color=color,lw=lw,zorder=1))

MIE='#ffd9b3';KE='#cfe8ff';AO='#ffc6c6';INF='#d9b3ff';STR='#d9f2d9'
box(0.1,10.0,6.0,0.75,"STRESSORS: cyclosporin A/tacrolimus | IL-1R antagonist | JAK3 inhibitors (tofacitinib) | PACs/benzo[a]pyrene/TCDD (AhR agonists)",STR,7.8)

y154,y277,y315,yahr=8.5,6.6,4.7,2.8
xM,xK1,xK2=0.2,3.1,6.0; wB,hB=2.5,1.3
rows=[(y154,"MIE: Calcineurin inhibition [AOP 154]","KE: Reduced NFAT nuclear translocation","KE: Reduced NFAT/AP-1; IL-2 & IL-4 suppression"),
      (y277,"MIE: Impaired IL-1R1 signaling [AOP 277]","KE: NF-κB inhibition","KE: Suppression of T-cell activation"),
      (y315,"MIE: JAK3 inhibition [AOP 315]","KE: STAT5 inhibition; reduced promoter binding","KE: IL-4 suppression"),
      (yahr,"MIE: AhR activation (chemical) [PAC/TCDD]","KE: reduced B-cell differentiation (Bcl-6/Blimp-1/Pax5)","KE: suppressed antibody-forming cell (AFC) response")]
for yy,m,k1,k2 in rows:
    box(xM,yy,wB,hB,m,MIE); box(xK1,yy,wB,hB,k1,KE); box(xK2,yy,wB,hB,k2,KE)

yAO=5.5
box(11.9,yAO,2.7,1.6,"ADVERSE OUTCOME: Impaired TDAR (SRBC/KLH antibody-forming-cell response)",AO,9)
box(11.9,2.5,2.7,1.4,"Increased susceptibility to infection (reduced host resistance; increased mortality)",INF,8.5)

for yy,_,_,_ in rows:
    arrow(xM+wB,yy+hB/2,xK1,yy+hB/2); arrow(xK1+wB,yy+hB/2,xK2,yy+hB/2)
    arrow(xK2+wB,yy+hB/2,11.9,yAO+0.8)
    arrow(6.1,10.0,xM+0.4,yy+hB)
arrow(13.25,yAO,13.25,3.9,color='purple',lw=2.4)
ax.text(13.55,4.7,"Luster 1993\n(quantitative)\nBohrer 2018 (TB)\nCippà 2015\n(clinical)",fontsize=7.5,va='center')

handles=[mpatches.Patch(fc=STR,ec='k',label='Stressors'),
         mpatches.Patch(fc=MIE,ec='k',label='Molecular Initiating Event'),
         mpatches.Patch(fc=KE,ec='k',label='Key Event'),
         mpatches.Patch(fc=AO,ec='k',label='Adverse Outcome (impaired TDAR)'),
         mpatches.Patch(fc=INF,ec='k',label='Downstream: infection')]
ax.legend(handles=handles,loc='lower left',fontsize=8.5,frameon=True)
ax.set_xlim(0,15.6); ax.set_ylim(2,11)
ax.set_title("Integrated AOP Network: Convergence on Impaired TDAR and Increased Susceptibility to Infection",fontsize=12,fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('tdar_aop_network.png',dpi=130,bbox_inches='tight')
print("Saved tdar_aop_network.png")
